request.subject: TERRAIN:MOUNTAIN

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass and soil slab and the loose boulders under the mountain, so the rock and the small pine trees stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the peaks, snow, grey rock, pines, outline and art style exactly the same.
